question: Sahil travelled a certain distance by bike at the rate of 25 kmph. And walked back at the rate of 4 kmph. If the whole journey took 5 hours 48 minutes, what was the distance?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the same distance is covered at speeds S₁ and S₂ with total time T, Distance (D) = T × (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Given, S₁ = 25 kmph, S₂ = 4 kmph, T = 5 hours 48 mins = 29/5 hours.

⇒ D = (29/5) × (25 × 4) ÷ (25 + 4)

⇒ D = (29/5) × (100/29)

⇒ D = 100 ÷ 5 = 20 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 Start
 End
 
 
• 
 
 

 

 Bike: 25 kmph
 
 

 

 Walk: 4 kmph

 Distance = D
 
 Total Time = 5 hr 48 min

**Given:**

Speed of bike (S₁) = 25 kmph

Speed while walking (S₂) = 4 kmph

Total journey time (T) = 5 hours 48 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total time (T) = 5 + (48 ÷ 60) hours = 5 + 4/5 = 29/5 hours

⇒ Let the one-way distance be D km.

⇒ Time taken by bike = D / 25 hours

⇒ Time taken walking = D / 4 hours

⇒ Total Time = (D / 25) + (D / 4) = 29/5

⇒ (4D + 25D) ÷ 100 = 29/5

⇒ 29D / 100 = 29/5

⇒ D / 100 = 1/5

⇒ D = 100 ÷ 5 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

When a person covers a certain distance at speed x and returns the same distance at speed y, the average speed for the whole journey is (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Proportionality of Speed and Time

For a fixed distance, speed is inversely proportional to time. If the ratio of speeds is a : b, then the ratio of time taken will be b : a.

Relative Speed

If two objects move in opposite directions at speeds S₁ and S₂, their relative speed is S₁ + S₂. If moving in the same direction, it is |S₁ − S₂|.
